# `foxglove completion`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](README.md)

```text
Generate a shell completion script

Usage: foxglove completion [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  bash        Generate completions for Bash
  fish        Generate completions for Fish
  powershell  Generate completions for PowerShell
  zsh         Generate completions for Zsh
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
